summary: No Forest Service page for Abes Run found: the Monongahela NF recreation and camping listings name no Abes Run / FR 51 / East Fork Greenbrier dispersed area, and slug guesses 404. Existing reported values (WVU DIY Outdoors, Campendium) left as they are; nothing confirmed.
flags: Missing agency website: no fs.usda.gov page exists for Abes Run dispersed camping (the Monongahela's recreation and Camping & Cabins listings carry no entry for it; /recreation/abes-run* 404). Nearest official contact: Greenbrier Ranger District, 304-456-3335 (per search listing; not read from an FS page). The only descriptions are WVU DIY Outdoors (https://diyoutdoors.wvu.edu/camping/abes-run-dispersed-camping) and Campendium.

Criteria: the Forest Service does not designate these as drive-in campsites on any page found, so nothing official says a 23-ft motorhome can reach them. FR 51 (Abes Run Rd) is a dirt forest road; Campendium: 'Accessibility is not guaranteed, always scout ahead before driving down dirt roads'. The entry rests on AWH's firsthand note and aggregator reports (a 36-ft fifth wheel reported). Dispersed with no FS-designated sites - a human should decide whether it stays.
AWH's note also says 'Sites on far side of the river may not be accessible when water is high' - consistent with WVU's description; no conflict.
